data.change_summary: Verified that HEAD already carried the pending runtime fixes: egg dropping already uses the named `egg_drop_temp_swing_c` path via `last_temp_swing_c`, and density-suppressed berried events already surface `EventCause::HighDensity` with density details. The implementation work in this pass therefore focused on locking those amendments down with explicit regression coverage by updating `reproduction_factors.rs` to prove a first-day 4°C shock can trigger egg dropping before the smoothed instability index crosses its generic threshold, and to require high-density berried events to emit `HighDensity` plus density diagnostics. I then revalidated the adjacent save/load, tracing, event, full `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` surfaces on the current branch.

steps.description: Inspected the shrimp reproduction, egg-drop, stability-tracker, and event paths against the pending amendments and confirmed the runtime-side `egg_drop_temp_swing_c` and `HighDensity` behavior was already present at HEAD.

Updated `crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs` so the sudden egg-drop regression now exercises the direct same-day temperature-swing path and added a dedicated regression requiring high-density berried events to include `EventCause::HighDensity` and density details.
Ran targeted regressions plus broader package validation to confirm the strengthened coverage and the surrounding save/load, tracing, event, and scenario surfaces all still pass.
